item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera fixes a small torch bulb to an electric cell using two wires, as shown in the figure. The bulb lights up.

Which statement about the cell is correct?

options.A: The metal disc is the positive terminal and the metal cap is the negative terminal; the cell supplies electrical energy to the circuit.
options.B: The metal cap is the positive terminal and the metal disc is the negative terminal; the cell supplies electrical energy to the circuit.
options.C: Either end of the cell can be the positive terminal; the shape of the cap and disc does not matter.
options.D: The metal cap is the positive terminal, but the cell cannot supply energy unless two cells are joined together.
